publicCopy.titleZh: ERCOT 启动面向拟并网 25MW 以上数据中心的州与社区影响 RFI
publicCopy.titleEn: ERCOT launches state and community impact RFI for data centers pursuing 25MW-plus interconnection
publicCopy.summaryZh: ERCOT 要求拟并网 25MW 及以上数据中心开发商提交州与社区影响信息；这不是项目互连、送电或建设批准。
publicCopy.summaryEn: ERCOT is seeking state and community impact information from data-center developers pursuing interconnection at 25MW or above; this is not project approval.

publicClaims.claim: ERCOT's RFI covers developers pursuing ERCOT interconnection at 25MW or above and has an October 12 submission deadline.

internalNotes: The item was carried from the incomplete morning review and reread from ERCOT's primary page; no project list or MW total is disclosed.

publicCopy.titleZh: PJM 提出大型计算负荷在电网扰动中的 ride-through 要求
publicCopy.titleEn: PJM proposes ride-through requirements for large computational loads
publicCopy.summaryZh: PJM 拟要求包括数据中心在内的大型计算负荷在通常可清除的输电扰动中保持接入；提案尚未生效。
publicCopy.summaryEn: PJM proposes that large computational loads, including data centers, remain connected through normally cleared transmission disturbances; the proposal is not effective yet.

publicClaims.claim: PJM proposes ride-through requirements for large computational loads and plans a November filing with FERC.

internalNotes: The item was retained by the September 15 candidate ledger and reread from PJM's original post; it is a proposal, not an approved standard or capacity allocation.

The CAC 2026-2030 implementation plan was read and contains data-center efficiency, liquid-cooling, 800V DC and high-density-rack language, but it predates this window and requires an explicit prior-public-record and policy-route review before any new card.

The National Data Administration item is an official September 12 policy-news summary, but the underlying State Council record and any binding implementation status were not located in this bounded scan. Do not publish its planning language as an effective rule.
